name: LikeButton
description: A like toggle whose heart squashes and pops as it fills, firing a shockwave ring and a burst of particles while the counter rolls to the next number. Works as a pill with a count, a ghost button, or a bare icon.
a11yNotes: Native toggle <button> with aria-pressed. Its aria-label combines `label` and the current count (e.g. "Like, 129"); the visual icon, counter and particles are aria-hidden. Particles use a seeded layout, so server and client markup match. Under prefers-reduced-motion the pop, burst and rolling digits are replaced by an instant fill and a cross-fade.

propsApi.name: onLikedChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next liked state.

propsApi.name: count
propsApi.description: Like count excluding the current user's like; the displayed number adds 1 while liked.

propsApi.name: showCount
propsApi.description: Show the rolling counter (ignored for the icon variant).

propsApi.name: variant
propsApi.description: Bordered pill, borderless ghost, or round icon-only button.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the filled icon, ring and particles.

propsApi.name: particleCount
propsApi.description: Number of burst particles (0 disables the burst, max 32).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
